name: ob1-extensions-tests

scripts.sync-auth: for d in _shared ../recipes/_shared ../recipes/editorial-policy/_shared ../recipes/edge-function-cost-optimization/examples/_shared ../integrations/_shared ../integrations/consolidation-workers/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/auth.ts "$d/auth.ts"; done

comment: Test-only (SMD-1252, FORK.md change 64): test-auth.ts imports the seven extension servers, and since change 67 (SMD-1455) the vendored recipes' and integrations' servers, as deployed. Versions are pinned EXACTLY to the extensions' deno.json — one file, six identical copies — and to server-portable/package.json, so the test exercises the libraries the functions deploy with; test-auth.ts fails if any of those deno.json files, or a recipe's or integration's npm pin, drifts. Bump all of them in the same commit. No types package: bun runs the test untyped, and nothing type-checks this directory. `bun run sync-auth` rewrites every _shared/auth.ts from server-portable/auth.ts; the test names the six and fails if one differs.
